name: The Tome of Valor
summary: In Stormwind and Ironforge, young Alliance paladins face a trial of courage and duty. Their mentors ask them to prove they can fight with skill and protect the innocent.

sections.title: The Measure of a Paladin
sections.body: Young paladins in Stormwind and Ironforge must face terrible danger without faltering. Their instructors test their resolve in the Cathedral of Light and the Hall of Mysteries. Dragons and demons may threaten those who cannot defend themselves. The paladins must stay beside them.

sections.title: Virtues of the Order
sections.body: A holy warrior needs bravery as much as a weapon and shield. The trial teaches paladins that strength means little without a firm vow to shelter the helpless. When danger threatens the Alliance, its defenders must hold their ground and protect those in their care.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Tome of Valor?
faq.answer: The Tome of Valor tests whether an Alliance paladin has the courage and selfless resolve to protect the vulnerable. Mentors of the Holy Light use the trial to judge an initiate's readiness to advance in the order.

faq.q: Who directs paladins on this trial?
faq.answer: Senior paladins in Alliance capitals guide initiates through the trial. Duthorian Rall calls them from the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind, while Tiza Battleforge does so from Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries.

aliases: what comes after tome of valor
faq.answer: The initial call leads into a series of trials that test a paladin's resolve. They take the initiate into danger in defense of the realm and the innocent.

faq.q: Why is bravery so heavily emphasized for paladins?
faq.answer: Bravery helps a paladin keep faith and protect others when horrors such as demons or dragons threaten. Without courage, fear can break a warrior's spirit.

faq.q: Do dwarf and human paladins undertake the same test?
faq.answer: Human paladins train through Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, while dwarves train in Ironforge. Both traditions teach courage, duty, and defense of the helpless under the Light.

faq.q: What core lessons are outlined in the trial?
faq.answer: The trial teaches paladins to face danger with courage, shield the weak, and keep faith when terror comes.

angles.text: As a paladin, you face a rite that asks you to put duty to others ahead of your own safety as you become a trusted defender of the Holy Light.
As a human, you face this trial under Duthorian Rall's watch in the Cathedral of Light. It carries Stormwind's devotion to the Silver Hand's founding ideals.
As a dwarf, you train in Ironforge, where mentors like Tiza Battleforge ask you to show that your fortitude is guided by holy purpose.
As an Alliance champion, you prepare to defend settlements against threats ranging from local bandits to monstrous invaders.
